name: Linux - Security Analytics - Privileged Activity
description: Dashboard showing analytics for sudo attempts across accounts and systems.
title: Linux - Security Analytics - Privileged Activity

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/OS/linux/Security* sudo
| parse regex "\S*\s+\d+\s+\d+:\d+:\d+\s+(?<_sourceHost>\S*)\s+" nodrop
| _sourceHost as dest_host
| extract "(?<process>\w*):\s+(?<src_user>[^ ]+?)\s+:.+?USER=(?<dest_user>[^ ]+?)\s+" nodrop
| parse "TTY=* ; PWD=* ;" as tty, workingdirectory nodrop
| parse "USER=* ;" as dest_user nodrop
| where process="sudo"
| where src_user matches "{{src_user}}"
| where dest_user matches "{{dest_user}}"
| where dest_host matches "{{dest_host}}"
| timeslice 15m
| count as eventCount by _timeslice
| sort _timeslice
